scripts.check: bun run check:toolchains && bun run contracts:check && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run check:security && bun run check:licenses
scripts.check:licenses: bun run check:cargo-licenses && bun run check:js-licenses
scripts.contracts:check: cargo run --quiet -p adoc-contract-codegen -- --check && bun run packages/contracts/scripts/generate.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-contracts.mjs && bun run --cwd packages/contracts test
scripts.lint: bun run check:boundaries && biome lint . && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --all-targets && bun run check:boundaries:self-test && bun run --sequential --workspaces --if-present test
